### Week Selector

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Load available weeks from JSON metadata
weeks = FileAttachment("plots/weeks.json").json()

// Create dropdown selector
viewof selectedWeek = Inputs.select(
  weeks,
  {
    value: weeks[weeks.length - 1], // Default to latest week
    label: "Choose Week:",
    format: (x) => `Week ${x}`
  }
)
```

::: {.card}
**Selected Week:** ${selectedWeek}

**Total Weeks:** ${weeks.length}
:::

## About This Dashboard

This dashboard displays fantasy football quadrant analysis for the **730UFFL** league. Each plot shows team performance by comparing:

- **Points For (PF)**: Total points scored by a team (x-axis)
- **Points Against (PA)**: Total points scored against a team (y-axis)

### Quadrant Interpretation

- 🔵 **Light Blue (Top Right)**: Elite teams - high scoring offense, strong defense
- 🔵 **Blue (Bottom Right)**: Good offense, bad defense - score a lot but give up points
- 🔴 **Red (Top Left)**: Bad offense, good defense - struggle to score but play good defense
- 🟥 **Pink (Bottom Left)**: Struggling teams - low scoring and weak defense

Use the dropdown above to view standings after any completed week of the season.
